text:
alice: CI red on main after the redis-client bump — automation flagged 12 failures in integration/kvstore on linux-r2-small pool. Seeing 'Connection reset by peer' in the logs. Anyone able to kick off a bisect?

dev-bot: CI run: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/8842 — failed tests: integration/kvstore/*. Re-run id: 8842.1

ben: I'll take a look, starting a local repro. can someone paste last-green commit?

carla: last green was commit 0a1b2c3d (merge PR #7775) — https://git.redwood/commit/0a1b2c3d

dave: quick skim of failing logs shows repeated 'write: Connection reset by peer' from the redis client. suspect changed socket behavior in the upgrade. snippet:

```
E kvstore_integ.cc:128: connect failed: Connection reset by peer
  #0 redis_client.cc:304  redis_client.cc:112  test_runner.cc:45
  errno: ECONNRESET
```

emma: note: failures only on r2-small runners (low FD counts). could be fd leak or higher concurrency default in new client. try running with ulimit -n 4096 or set REDIS_CLIENT_MAX_CONN=20

ben: starting a bisect between 0a1b2c3d..def5678 now. will post updates. :eyes:

dev-bot: Bisect job queued: `/bisect start --range 0a1b2c3d..def5678 --tests integration/kvstore --parallel 4` — job id 9921

ben: bisect progress: narrowed to PR #7823 (redis-client: 4.2.0 -> 5.0.1). repro reproduces on r2-small with fd limit 1024.

carla: I'm the author of #7823 — we changed connection pool defaults and enabled keepalive by default. didn't expect this on tiny runners.

dave: mitigation plan: revert PR #7823 to get CI green, then land a fix that reduces pool size / closes idle conns. can someone open an emergency revert?

ben: opening revert PR now -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7830 (revert: revert "redis client upgrade")

emma: once revert merged I'll kick a canary run on the dedicated lane and monitor the r2-small pool. also filing issue to add a regression test for fd exhaustion. https://git.redwood/issue/INC-1199

carla: I pushed a smaller follow-up that closes idle conns and respects REDIS_CLIENT_MAX_CONN; will hold it until revert is in and CI is stable.

alice: thanks everyone — land the revert, run canary, and monitor for 1 hour. post status here when canary is green. :thumbsup:

ben: revert merged and canary started (job 8843.1). will report back in ~15m.

dev-bot: Canary job 8843.1: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/8843 — queued on dedicated lane

ben: canary passed on dedicated lane and r2-small re-runs look green so far. marking this as triaged. follow-ups: INC-1199 (reg test), and PR #7831 (client fd fix)

alice: great work — leaving postmortem todo for next sprint. thanks!
